routing_model.algorithm: Deterministic round-robin across eight per-leg bounded FIFO queues; one admitted through oxygen ingress per tick, one previously admitted packet leaves oxygen egress per tick
routing_model.identity: source leg, family, unique packet ID, destination preserved
routing_model.capacity: One packet per tick per ingress and egress
routing_model.packet_loss: Queue overflow explicitly logged; no silent loss claimed

browser.mode: full HTML browser with original optical simulation

limitations: The routing engine is software scheduling, not observed photonic carrier dynamics.
Hot hydrogen, cold nitrogen, neutral oxygen are categorical identities/colors, not measured chemical or thermal operations.
The eightfold 8^4 levels are logical address geometry, not separately fabricated waveguides.
One shared oxygen body includes separate modeled ingress and egress stages; full-duplex behavior is simulated.
